description:
Browse skins with the site's filters and sorts. One page of skin cards exactly as the /skins browser shows them: `itemdefid`, `name`, icons, `category`,
`item_collection`, `market_hash_name`, flags (`is_twitch_drop`, `is_limited_time`, `marketable`, `tradable`,
`is_permanent`...), `price` (canonical wiki price in cents, null when Steam has no listing), `subscriptions`
(Workshop subscribers, the site's supply proxy), `store_price` (the original item-store price in cents),
`store_change_pct` (market price vs store price) and `released` (date accepted into the store). Filters combine
with AND. `total` is the filtered count; results are cached for 120 seconds per filter combination.

breakable.description: Only skins with a recycle yield (`recycle_hint`).

color.description: Dominant icon colour bucket; matches any of a skin's up to five dominant colours.

creator.description: Workshop creator: a 17-digit SteamID64 for an exact match, or part of the creator's display name.

hide_drops.description: Hide loot-crate drops, publisher drops and Twitch drops (what the site calls DLCs and drops).

item.description: Base item shortname, e.g. `rifle.ak` - every skin of that one item.

min_subs.description: Minimum Steam Workshop subscriber count of the skin's original submission.

released.description: Year the skin was accepted into the item store.

search.description: Fuzzy name search (trigram similarity; with sort=name results are relevance-ordered). Searches are never cached server-side.

sort.description: Ordering. `popularity` and `supply_asc` use Workshop subscribers; `trending` is the 7-day price change; `marketcap_desc` is price x subscribers.

name: browse_skins
title: Browse skins with the site's filters and sorts
